_comment_deepseek: DeepSeek HTTP backend. Leave deepseek_api_key empty (or set to ${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}) to disable. When set, a 'deepseek' BackendSpec is auto-registered and /d /deepseek shortcuts become active.
_comment_intent_router: Phase 5 intent router. Defaults to 10% gray rollout (intent_router_enabled=true, intent_router_traffic=0.1). Set traffic to 0.0 or enabled to false to disable.
_comment_injection_gate: P0 injection gate — api_skip_recent_turns_when_history (default true): skip the 100 KB recent-turns disk read when the target backend is an API backend (anthropic_api / google_api / openai_compat_api). These backends carry conversation history structurally via load_history() and already ignore recent_turns in _run_backend_single, so the pre-read is pure I/O waste. Set false to restore pre-gate behaviour.
_comment_injection_gates_p1: P1 on-demand injection gates (all false = inject as before). memory_intent_policy_enabled: when true, global memory ([GLOBAL MEMORY]...[/GLOBAL MEMORY]) is stripped from extra_system when the resolved intent is dev/crew/shell — saves 200–800 tokens for code/task queries that don't need user style/format preferences. crew_sticky_keyword_gate_enabled: when true, sticky crew context injection is skipped unless the user message contains crew-related keywords (crew, /dev, /plan, agent, 任务, 流水线, pipeline, checkpoint) — avoids injecting 1–4 KB of crew summary into casual chat turns; note that consume_recent_crew_context is still called so the injection counter advances correctly. project_guide_enabled + project_guide_path: when enabled, the file at project_guide_path (≤4000 chars, truncated beyond) is prepended to extra_system for non-claude-cli backends (Gemini/Kimi/DeepSeek) so they learn project conventions; claude_cli backends skip since they read CLAUDE.md themselves. All gates emit larkhelm_injection_gate_total{point, outcome} regardless of prometheus-client availability.
_comment_memory_phase_b: Phase B memory token-optimization (S49–S53). All flags default to true; flip individually to bisect a token regression without redeploying. memory_session_gc_enabled triggers a daemon that unlinks session_*.md older than memory_session_gc_max_age_days.
_comment_memory_recent_turns_dedup: P0-3 已接通真实 dedup 路径（之前仅占位）：log._get_recent_turns 接收 dedup_prefix=session.work_context，命中前 60 字符匹配的 turn 会被跳过。
_comment_crew_phase_c: Phase C crew enhancements. crew_breakpoint_timeout_sec controls how long /dev waits for the user to click 继续/取消 before auto-cancelling (default 1800s = 30 min). task_profiles are referenced by larkhelm/crew/_backend_resolver.py — the in-code defaults are authoritative; this comment lists them for operator awareness: planner / engineer / qa / reviewer / chat. To override per-profile capability weights in the future, populate task_profiles[<name>] with required_capabilities / latency_pref / require_tools.
_comment_crew_sentinel_layer2: SEC-CRIT-4 layer-2 sentinel heuristic (see .crew_workspace/review_security.md). Layer-1 in crew/_runner.py:_validate_output_artifact is bypassable by wrapping tool-call tokens in fenced / inline-backtick / blockquote citations — the scrubber strips them, layer-1 misses. Layer-2 counts RAW sentinel occurrences (pre-scrub) and rejects on either: (a) raw_hits >= raw_threshold AND drop_ratio (1 - prose_len/content_len) > drop_ratio, or (b) raw_hits >= paranoid_threshold regardless of citation form. Defaults are intuition-based; the larkhelm_crew_validate_layer2_total{outcome, mode} Counter ALWAYS fires (mode=observe when traffic bucket misses) so operators can calibrate thresholds before flipping crew_sentinel_layer2_enabled=true. Roll out gradually via crew_sentinel_layer2_traffic (chat_id-salted bucket).
_comment_crew_sentinel_anthropic_loose: SEC-v2-MED-1 (see .crew_workspace/review_security_v2.md). Earlier batch added <function_calls> + <invoke name= to _OUTPUT_SENTINELS as bare substring matches — that over-fired on narrative prose that legitimately mentions either tag (Claude API docs, agent prompt tutorials, larkhelm CLAUDE.md sections). Replaces with a structural regex that requires the FULL opening + invoke + closing trio within a 4 KiB window — the shape only arises from a real non-tool backend leak. crew/_runner.py:_anthropic_loose_check emits larkhelm_crew_validate_anthropic_loose_total{outcome=hit_enforced|hit_observed} on every match so operators can verify the structural pattern matches reality even when enforcement is off. Default true (we want enforcement immediately — false positives on the structural shape are not plausible). Flip to false to fall back to metric-only observation.
_comment_crew_backend_exclusion_cooldown: SEC-v2-MED-2 (see .crew_workspace/review_security_v2.md). After validate-failure, _run_agent_wrapper excludes the failing backend for `crew_backend_exclusion_cooldown_sec` seconds (default 60). Cross-round retry-target reset only prunes EXPIRED entries (was unconditional clear before the fix) — a backend that just failed stays excluded across an immediate retry, breaking the backend-swing DoS where an attacker forces one backend to validate-fail every round. Each re-exclusion within a crew also bumps larkhelm_crew_backend_swing_total{agent_id} so operators can spot abuse. Set 0 to restore pre-fix byte-compatible behaviour.
_comment_p1: P1 iteration knobs (all disabled by default). health_endpoint_port=0 disables the HTTP /health /ready /metrics endpoint (Prometheus-compatible); set a port > 0 (eg. 9300) and configure your reverse proxy to scrape it. health_bind_addr defaults to 127.0.0.1 — DO NOT bind 0.0.0.0 unless behind an authenticated proxy. query_session_v2_enabled enables the QuerySession rewrite of _do_query (PR2, default false). memory_session_layer_smart enables three-section smart_truncate per memory_session_layer_budgets (default true; flip to false for byte-compat with pre-P1). memory_cascade_midflight_cancel makes background memory extracts abort their LLM call as soon as a new chat turn lands (default true; flip false to fall back to post-LLM cancel only).
_comment_p2: P2 iteration knobs. metrics_text_legacy=true forces /metrics to the P1 hand-written exposition even when prometheus-client is installed (useful when bisecting a metrics regression). memory_extract_buffer_window_sec>0 buffers session-summary cascades for N seconds so a burst of turns triggers exactly one extract; 0 = disable buffer, fire each cascade immediately (P1 behaviour). memory_session_smart_compress=true switches session-layer trimming from tail truncation to score-based top-K sentence selection (deterministic, no LLM). memory_global_profile_slot_enabled (P5-OPT6 default true): rewrites global memory as 4 typed slots (style/format/domain/expertise, ≤200 chars each) so a local edit doesn't rotate the whole body; legacy free-form text auto-parses into the style slot (backward compatible). memory_project_section_enabled (P5-OPT6 default true): rewrites project memory as 4 fixed H2 sections (TechStack/Conventions/Architecture/Constraints) so the cheap-LLM extractor outputs targeted patches instead of full rewrites.
_comment_memory_phase_d2: Phase D / Phase 2 — on-demand memory recall stack. All flags default to keyword-only (Phase 1 behaviour); flip `embedding_enabled=true` AND set `embedding_traffic>0` AND `embedding_backend!="none"` to roll out hybrid recall. Stages roll out independently: Stage A (`memory_retriever_traffic`) is Phase 1, Stage B (`embedding_traffic`) is Phase 2. Both must hit for a chat to use hybrid; otherwise it stays on the Phase 1 keyword path. memory_retriever_mode='auto' means follow POLICY_TABLE per agent_type; override globally with 'keyword'|'embedding'|'hybrid'. memory_stale_window_days controls how many days of audit JSONL we scan to decide whether a slice has been forgotten (default 30; runtime source of truth is larkhelm/config.py); memory_stale_decay multiplies the relevance score of stale slices (0.5 = halve). memory_audit_rotate_max_mb gives the rollover threshold per day; memory_audit_retain_days unlinks anything older than this many days. embedding_model_path defaults to ~/.larkhelm/models/bge-small-zh-v1.5.onnx; download instructions: see README.md "Phase D 召回灰度开关".
_comment_memory_phase_d3: Phase D / Phase 3 — LLM-driven memory router (Stage C). Decorator on top of the keyword/hybrid retriever: the cheap-tier LLM picks the most relevant slices from the top-N candidate pool for high-complexity /crew and /dev tasks. ALL of these must hold for the LLM to run: memory_llm_router_enabled=true AND memory_llm_router_traffic > 0 (per-chat hash bucket, independent salt from Stage A/B) AND agent_type ∈ {crew, dev} AND request.complexity == 'high'. Per-chat rate limit caps cost. Cache reuses verdicts within memory_llm_router_cache_ttl_sec for identical (query, candidate-set) pairs. All failure paths fall back to the underlying retriever output silently; the audit JSONL records `llm_router_*` fields so /memory audit-summary can show invocation rate.
_comment_admin_cards: P3 REQ-07 / P1-1a — orange admin cards for diagnostic failures. plugin_report_card_enabled pushes boot-time plugin load failures (PluginLoadReport) to admin_chat_id; failure_report_card_enabled is the P1-1a generic failure_report.emit() entry point (cascade backoff exhausted / circuit open / etc., wired in P1-1b/c). Both default false to stay byte-compatible. admin_chat_id is the target chat for both.
_comment_probe_models: Optional. If omitted, installed CLIs are auto-discovered from PATH (no model pinning or capabilities). Uncomment and customize to pin models and enable orchestrator routing hints.

probe_models._comment: DeepSeek via HTTP. Auto-registered when deepseek_api_key is non-empty; this explicit entry only matters if you want to pin a different model or set a custom base_url per backend. cost_per_1k_* + capability_scores + latency_tier let intent_router L2 cheap-tier auto-select DeepSeek when Gemini-flash is unavailable. NOTE: do NOT add 'tools' to tags — the HTTP runner does not implement function calling, and adding it would let rank_for_task pick DeepSeek for require_tools=True tasks.
probe_models.capabilities: Cheap, fast Chinese-friendly chat model. Good for high-volume drafting and summarization where Claude/Gemini cost is wasteful.
probe_models._cost_comment: USD per 1K tokens (cache-miss rate; Apr-2026 list price). Update if DeepSeek changes pricing.
